title: Let's Do Turbulence Right: In Space and Time!
abstract: arXiv:2610.32601v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The three-dimensional Navier-Stokes equations govern fluid turbulence, a chaotic and non-linear physical phenomenon characterized by complex eddies interacting across vast spatial and temporal scales. A numerically accurate modeling of this multi-scale energy cascade requires fully resolving both the fine spatial structures and the continuous temporal evolution of the flow field. In this paper, we leverage massive, time-resolved direct numerical simulations, which exceed 28 TB per run, to assess how numerical choices govern the resolved (3+1)-dimensional physics of turbulent flows. Building on this analysis, we study how neural networks represent the recorded turbulent motion. Our results highlight that spatial and temporal assessments can disagree for both numerical records and learned representations. We therefore call on the machine learning community to treat (3+1)-dimensional turbulence as a four-dimensional phenomenon.

translated_title: 让我们正确处理湍流：在空间与时间上！
translated_abstract: 三维纳维-斯托克斯方程支配着流体湍流，这是一种混沌的非线性物理现象，其特征是复杂涡旋在广阔的空间和时间尺度上相互作用。要对这种多尺度能量级联进行数值精确建模，需要同时完全解析流场的精细空间结构和连续的时间演化。在本文中，我们利用大规模的时间解析直接数值模拟（每次运行超过28 TB）来评估数值选择如何决定湍流中可解析的(3+1)维物理特性。在此分析的基础上，我们研究了神经网络如何表示所记录的湍流运动。我们的结果强调，无论是对于数值记录还是学习到的表示，空间评估和时间评估都可能得出不一致的结论。因此，我们呼吁机器学习社区将(3+1)维湍流视为一种真正的四维现象。
tldr: 本文利用每次运行超过28 TB的大规模时间解析直接数值模拟，发现湍流的空间与时间评估可能不一致，呼吁机器学习社区将(3+1)维湍流视为四维现象，同时充分解析其空间结构和时间演化。
en_tdlr: Using massive time-resolved direct numerical simulations exceeding 28 TB per run, this paper demonstrates that spatial and temporal assessments of turbulence can disagree, and calls on the machine learning community to treat (3+1)-dimensional turbulence as a fully four-dimensional phenomenon.
